faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Important information before buying resources or opening a store on E-KRU Marketplace.

freeStore.question: Is registration and opening a store free?
freeStore.answer: Creating an account and submitting a store application are free. Once your store is approved, you can add products and submit them for publication review.

fees.question: What are the selling fees?
fees.answer: E-KRU's standard commission is 10% of the product amount actually paid after discounts, excluding shipping. Payment-processing fees may also apply: 0% for the platform's PromptPay flow, 3.65% + THB 10 for domestic cards through Stripe, 4.75% + THB 10 for international cards, plus 2% when currency conversion is required. A THB 100 PromptPay sale nets THB 90, while a domestic-card sale nets approximately THB 76.35 before tax, refunds, or adjustments. A store-specific rate shown on the seller finance page replaces the standard 10%.

payout.question: When will sellers receive their money?
payout.answer: After payment is verified, the default holding period is 7 days. Cleared balances of at least THB 100 enter the Friday payout cycle; smaller balances roll over to the next cycle. Bank holidays, risk reviews, or incorrect payout details may delay receipt. The seller finance page shows the current settings and next payout date.

eligibleSellers.question: Who can sell teaching resources?
eligibleSellers.answer: Teachers, individuals, schools, companies, publishers, and universities can apply. Sellers must verify their identity and payout account and accept the Marketplace agreements.

fileTypes.question: Which file types are supported?
fileTypes.answer: Supported formats include PDF, DOC/DOCX, PPT/PPTX, XLS/XLSX, ZIP, and JPG, PNG, or WebP images. Each product file may be up to 50 MB and cover images up to 5 MB.
